findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分客戶正開發競品或垂直整合以自有產品取代 TDY 產品；部分專利已到期或將到期，可能開放更多競爭；中國等國的競爭者可能受國家補貼而低價競爭。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Furthermore, some of our patents have expired or are expiring, which could open up further competition. Additionally, some of our customers have been developing competing products or electing to vertically integrate and replace our products with their own.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：中國、印度、沙烏地等國強化在地供應商與在地製造規定，已對 TDY 儀器、商用航太、海洋與數位影像營收造成負面影響；歐洲國防採購漸要求歐盟境內產線，TDY 若無法因應可能失去標案給歐盟業者。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Many countries, including China, India and Saudi Arabia, have bolstered laws or regulations requiring the use of local suppliers, personnel and in-country manufacturing, which has had a negative impact on Teledyne’s revenues of instrumentation, commercial aerospace, marine and digital imaging products, as we currently have limited manufacturing operations in these countries.

findings.claim: 10-K 競爭段：TDY 認為競爭者眾多且無單一對手提供相同產品線或涵蓋所有市場；各市場高度競爭，許多對手規模、裝機量與資源更大。公司未揭露份額數字。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Business - Competition
findings.excerpt: we encounter a wide variety of competitors, none of which we believe offer the same product and service lines or serve all of the same markets as we do.

note: 四次搜尋均查無 TDY 份額消長的量化來源，亦無具名新進入者或對手設計案搶單的來源；搜尋結果多為股價聚合頁，未採用。僅採一手 10-K 摘錄。
